purpose: Sections 11/14/15: freeze the exact per-dimension agreement computation and thresholds BEFORE any adjudication. Not adjusted after seeing results (Section 25).

studyDesign.adjudicatorIdentity: Three separately-dispatched, mutually-isolated general-purpose subagents (A, B, C), each receiving an identical frozen instruction packet (05-operational-rubric.json + a blinded evidence packet), with no access to V2's own atomic disposition for any case, the other two adjudicators, or any historical evaluator record (V2's 12-state disposition, prior phases' agreement results, or known false-credit identification).

agreementComputation_perDimension.principle: Section 14: agreement is computed INDEPENDENTLY per dimension - never one giant exact-match score requiring simultaneous agreement across all 5.

creditEligibility.pairwiseRawAgreement: For each pair of adjudicators, fraction of cases where both assigned the same value.
creditEligibility.unanimousAgreement: Fraction of cases where all 3 adjudicators assigned the same value.
creditEligibility.majorityStability: Always 100% by construction (2-valued space, pigeonhole) - reported for completeness only, not informative.

surfacingStatus.scope: Computed ONLY over cases where a MAJORITY (2-of-3) of adjudicators independently assigned creditEligibility=NO_CREDIT for that case (the 'applicable' NO_CREDIT cases) - a case all 3 rated CREDIT contributes no information about surfacing and is excluded from this denominator, not silently forced to NOT_APPLICABLE agreement.
surfacingStatus.pairwiseRawAgreement: Among applicable cases: fraction where both adjudicators in a pair assigned the same value (SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED vs NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED vs NOT_APPLICABLE).
surfacingStatus.unanimousAgreement: Fraction of applicable cases where all 3 agree.
surfacingStatus.confusionMatrix: 3x3 across all pairwise comparisons on applicable cases.

representationCompleteness.pairwiseRawAgreement: Fraction where both adjudicators in a pair assigned the same value (NONE/PARTIAL/FULL).

verificationStatus.scope: Only cases where a majority of adjudicators did NOT assign NOT_EVALUATED (i.e. at least one adjudicator believed genuine verification evidence existed to assess) - the 'genuinely applicable' subset per Section 15.
verificationStatus.chanceAdjustedStatistic: Fleiss' kappa if the applicable count is large enough to be non-degenerate.

evidenceQuality.pairwiseRawAgreement: Fraction where both adjudicators in a pair assigned the same value (SUFFICIENT/AMBIGUOUS/INSUFFICIENT).

consensusRule.definition: Majority (2-of-3) per dimension per case. For a 2-valued dimension (creditEligibility) a majority always exists. For 3+ valued dimensions, if all 3 adjudicators disagree with each other (a genuine 3-way split), mark that case's consensus for that dimension as UNRESOLVED_CONSENSUS - excluded from that dimension's evaluator-vs-consensus denominator, but reported separately, never silently dropped.

evaluatorVsConsensusGate.metric: raw agreement between evaluator's atomic creditEligibility and the majority consensus

creditEligibility.certificationClass: SAFETY_CRITICAL - blocks evaluator closure if either gate fails.

interReviewerGate.metric: mean pairwise raw agreement on applicable NO_CREDIT cases

evaluatorVsConsensusGate.metric: raw agreement on applicable NO_CREDIT cases

surfacingStatus.certificationClass: SAFETY_CRITICAL - blocks evaluator closure if either gate fails.

evaluatorVsConsensusGate.onlyAppliesIf: interReviewerGate passes and the dimension is designated CERTIFICATION_GRADE

representationCompleteness.certificationClass: DIAGNOSTIC - does NOT block evaluator closure. If interReviewerGate fails, mark DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and do not compute or require the evaluator-vs-consensus gate at all.

interReviewerGate.metric: mean pairwise raw agreement on genuinely applicable cases
interReviewerGate.threshold: NO certification threshold unless >= 15 genuinely applicable cases exist in the frozen sample - report reproducibility as a number regardless, but treat as diagnostic this phase even if >=15 cases exist and reproducibility is high, absent an explicit pre-results justification (none given here) to certify it

verificationStatus.certificationClass: DIAGNOSTIC - never blocks evaluator closure this phase.

falseCreditCrossCheck: Pre-registered: for each of the 14 historical false-credit controls present in the sample, report whether all 3 adjudicators independently assigned creditEligibility=NO_CREDIT. Any adjudicator assigning CREDIT to a known control is investigated before the gate result is accepted at face value (Section 16).
